events.title: Odd-sem & special-back exam form
events.notes: Closed on Oct 31, 2026. Missed it? Contact your college exam cell immediately — late submission goes through the college, not this site.

events.title: Odd-sem & special-back admit cards
events.notes: Released Nov 12, 2026. Log in with your enrollment number and password, download the PDF and print 2 copies. Check your name, roll number and exam centre the same day — errors take days to fix.

events.title: Odd-semester & special-back exams
events.notes: Nov 17 – Dec 5, 2026 for diploma odd semesters and special back papers. Reach the centre 30 minutes early; carry the printed admit card and college ID.

events.title: Odd-semester & special-back results
events.notes: To be announced — BTEUP usually declares odd-sem results 4–6 weeks after exams end (expect Jan–Feb 2027). We add the direct portal link here the day it goes live; this news page is where it will surface first.

events.title: Revaluation / scrutiny window
events.notes: Opens shortly after results, via your college with a per-subject fee. Decide within days of the marksheet — the window is short. Link will be added when the notice is out.
